mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.conversation_id, m.sender_id, m.client_msg_id, m.seq, m.msg_type, m.content, m.created_at, m.recalled_at, m.recalled_by, m.reply_to_id, m.reply_sender_id, m.reply_preview FROM im_message m INNER JOIN im_conversation_member cm ON cm.conversation_id = m.conversation_id AND cm.user_id = #{userId} WHERE m.recalled_at IS NULL AND m.msg_type IN (1, 6) AND m.seq > cm.cleared_seq AND m.content LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT m.id, m.conversation_id, m.sender_id, m.client_msg_id, m.seq, m.msg_type, m.content, m.created_at, m.recalled_at, m.recalled_by, m.reply_to_id, m.reply_sender_id, m.reply_preview FROM im_message m INNER JOIN im_conversation_member cm ON cm.conversation_id = m.conversation_id AND cm.user_id = #{userId} WHERE m.recalled_at IS NULL AND m.msg_type IN (2, 3, 4, 5) AND m.seq > cm.cleared_seq AND m.content LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
